items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: When I was working with Shilkret Shooret -- I was doing a lot of freelancing then.

ctx.x: Oh, this was -- this had to be around the early '30s, after I'd gotten out of the Whiteman band. When I was working with Shilkret Shooret -- I was doing a lot of freelancing then. And if these guys would go off the air, you had a lot of free time, and sometimes they'd go off -- and Willard would work during the summer.
